Let's have some fun by solving a cryptogram based on GtG. A cryptogram is a text where each letter is exchanged for a different letter, so "A" could be "B". By figuring out what each letter is, you will figure out the passage. In this cryptogram, only letter are exhanged with other letter. Non-letters (e.g. punctions marks, numbers, etc.) are correct, and should be left alone.

Each day, after the first, it the puzzle isn't solved yet, I will reveal one letter that hasn't already been revealed. Good luck!

Ix Paznctj etlk jtp ylzilvl ap slakp 2 eadaol xytd Bhknijo pnl Sidipk, pnaj ip ik elkpytcle. posts.cooked:
Yay cryptograms!

http://www.giantitp.com/comics/oots0248.html

If a hero does not take damage from an effect, such as Pushing the Limits, Solar Flare, etc.  Does the card remain in play? No, they have to take the damage listed on the card.  If Tachyon does not recieve at least 2 damage from Pushing the Limits, than it is destroyed. So if she is immune, redirected it, or reduced it to 1 damage, the card card has not fulfilled the condition and thus is destroyed.  This applies to Solar Flare as well, so no Imbued Fire + Flesh of the Sun God tricks. However the damage type can be anything, just as long as the amount of damage listed is taken, the card will remain.

There were some tricky parts, 3 of the letters were substituted with themselves and then "card card" was throwing me off until I realized it was probably a typo.

Did you use some application to create it?

So, when the black-winged man attacked her, claiming her to be one of his kind, she was taken aback. Bezaliel, as he called himself, pointed out all their similarities: their wings, their powers, even their swords! Bezaliel insisted to Fanatic throughout their fights that she was in fact his creation, and not a holy angel at all! Shaken, Fanatic fled from their initial confrontation, needing to meditate on these claims.
